family.description: This is the AlbA_2 domain from the Schlafen (SLFN) family of proteins which are important in cell differentiation and defense against viruses [[cite:PUB00151569],[cite:PUB00151570]]. This domain is present at the N-terminal of all SLFN proteins and includes the SLFN box, a sequence unique to these proteins that may form a dimer interface [[cite:PUB00151569]]. The AlbA_2 domain is RNA-binding and RNase region as it contains the highly conserved catalytic glutamic acid residues [[cite:PUB00151569]].
family.name: Schlafen, AlbA_2
